title: When the Bakery Sings
author: Dominic Underhill
blurb: Jonah Brightwater, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
